quest.title: Dust to Dust
quest.description: Having sought out the adepti and completed the task Moon Carver entrusted to you, you return again to Liyue Harbor to look for Childe. He tells you that the Liyue Qixing's response to the archon's passing has given him some food for thought...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x30, Mora x9300, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

talks.objective: Return to Liyue Harbor and find Childe

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: You've finally returned. How was your journey to Jueyun Karst?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Moon Carver, Mountain Shaper, Cloud Retainer, Conqueror of Demons...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Some of these names have never come up in the intel the Fatui gets hold of.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: As a returning gift, I too have information for you.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Regarding the archon's passing... The Liyue Qixing's response really has given me food for thought...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: They've announced that, as the true killer has not yet been found, they are not allowing anyone to pay their respects to the Exuvia.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: They've even gone so far as to try and cut off information... But with the Rite of Descension and all, even the Qixing isn't able to keep a lid on things.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It's common knowledge in Liyue that Rex Lapis is also an adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: The Geo Archon is also the God of Contracts, and is also known as the Exuvia, Prime of the Adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: The mighty and illuminated adepti of today all signed contracts to protect Liyue way back then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess that explains why they're all so focused on Liyue's well-being.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Naturally. They both have the responsibility and the aptitude for the job.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: If the ruling Qixing became unable to perform their duty properly, the adepti have the right to take corrective action.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: The Geo Archon's spirit has risen, so why would the Qixing hide his vessel? Truly suspicious.

choices.text: This makes things difficult for me too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Right! He's the whole reason we came here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If the Liyue Qixing has locked up Exuvia and won't let anyone near...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Then {NICKNAME}'s quest to find The Seven is already over!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Oh? You're trying to find The Seven? And just why might that be, pray tell?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: A knight that gets duped by the Fatui would really be no knight at all now, would they?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: But, I can help you with that too you know.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Someone who can help you break through this stalemate.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Truly fascinating. The harder they try to silence the situation, the greater the chaos that erupts...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If you want to be around to see it all come crashing down, best you stay alive until we next meet, yes?

choices.text: I agree, something is definitely not right.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Oh, you didn't get to see all the adepti yourself? ...Well, as they say, it's up to fate, no?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Not to worry! If you have the free time, there's no harm in giving it a go again.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Besides, the information on the Conqueror of Demons is already very valuable. As a returning gift, I too have information for you.
